regions.full_page: Maareen Naiditch - 15 - Infantile paralysis late last month in H. Kiefer's - stopped breathing for 20 minutes and nor for about a month has be breathing artificially. Enrolled in Ser. Masses three weeks ago (Aug. 3) and is very slowly improving. There is hope now of a possible recovery. Family ... promise more frequent communions ..... her classmates enroll her perpetually.
